name: Zebulun (Leah's son)
title: Ancestor of the tribe of Zebulun
summary: Zebulun was the sixth and youngest son of Jacob and Leah. His name means 'dwelling' or 'honor,' and Leah gave him this name because she hoped that Jacob would now dwell with her. Zebulun became the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes, which later settled in northern Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Zebulun
keyEvents.description: Zebulun was born as Leah's sixth son. Leah said: 'God has given me a good gift. Now my husband will live with me, for I have borne him six sons.'

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Zebulun traveled with his father Jacob and the rest of the family down to Egypt during the famine, to live in Goshen with Joseph.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob blessed his sons. Regarding Zebulun, he prophesied that his tribe would dwell by the seashore and be a haven for ships.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Zebulun
keyEvents.description: Zebulun had three sons: Sered, Elon and Jahleel, who became the ancestors of the clans in the tribe of Zebulun.

keyEvents.title: Moses' Blessing over Zebulun
keyEvents.description: Before his death, Moses blessed the tribes. Zebulun and Issachar were blessed together, with a promise of wealth from the sea and hidden treasures in the sand.
